en: Hello {main_tech}, {service} leaves {margin_hour} per chair hour against {min_hour} for its category. Let us talk about the time or the price.
Hello, the combo {combo} is open for booking: {minutes} minutes for {price}.
Hello, {service} leaves {margin_hour} per chair hour and {after_overhead} after the studio overhead. Please look at its price and time.
Hello, the menu review of {service} is ready: decision {decision}, margin per chair hour {margin_hour}. Next review {next_review}.
Owner: a price test has ended
Hello, the price test on {service} has ended. We tested {price_tested} against {price_before}. Result: {result}.
Owner: a promotion cost too much
Hello, the promotion {promotion} gave {discount_given} in discount and {revenue} in revenue. Each redemption cost {cost_per_redemption}.
Owner: a price rise is due soon
Hello, a price rise is due on {start_date}: {service} goes from {current_price} to {planned_price}. Expected monthly gain {monthly_gain}.
Hello, {studio} charges {price} for {service} and we charge {our_price}. The gap is {gap}.
Hello, for {service} the item {item} costs {unit_cost} a pack and the line costs {line_cost}. Please check the supplier price.
Hello, the discount given in the month of {date} is {discount_month}.
Hello, please update the price of {service} in the booking page to {planned_price} on {start_date}.
Front desk: print the new menu
Hello, please print the new menu. {service} is {price} for {minutes} minutes and holds a deposit of {deposit}.
Hello, please tell clients about the deposit rule: {rule}. The deposit is {deposit}, from a price of {price_from}.
Hello, the promotion {promotion} ends on {end_date}. Please stop offering it after that day.
Hello, the price of {item} ({pack}) changed and we now pay {unit_cost}. Please confirm your current price and the lead time of {lead_days} days.
Hello, the new price list is ready: {service} is {price} before tax and {price_tax} with local sales tax.
Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.
Price {col:services.price} before local sales tax, {col:services.price_tax} with local sales tax. Services of {set:deposit_from} or more need a deposit of {col:services.deposit} to hold the booking.
A prepaid package of {set:package_sessions} sessions costs {col:services.pack_price}. Ask the front desk about a combo with a second service.
A deposit is kept when you cancel inside the notice time or do not come. Prices may change with a notice.
Price check of a service against its category target
Category price check of {set:company}, dated {today}. Category {col:services.category}, service {col:services.service}.
Price {col:services.price}. Margin per chair hour {col:services.margin_hour} against a minimum of {col:services.min_hour} for the category. Verdict: {col:services.verdict}.
Average price of nearby studios {col:services.nearby_avg}. Position: {col:services.nearby_pos}.
Decision on the price and the owner of the action are written below.
Service costing sheet for one service
Service costing of {set:company}, dated {today}. Service {col:services.service_id}: {col:services.service}, {col:services.minutes} minutes, price {col:services.price}.

Product cost {col:services.product_cost}; cost from the product use list {col:services.use_cost}. Standard pay cost {col:services.std_pay}. Margin per service {col:services.margin} ({col:services.margin_pct} of the price).
Margin per chair hour {col:services.margin_hour}; after the studio overhead of each hour {col:services.after_overhead}. Verdict: {col:services.verdict}.
The costing is checked again whenever a product price or the pay model changes.
Notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. From {col:price_hist.date} the price of {col:price_hist.service} changes from {col:price_hist.old_price} to {col:price_hist.new_price}.
Reason: {col:price_hist.reason}. The change is {col:price_hist.change_pct} of the old price. Appointments booked before that date keep the old price.
Prices are before any local sales tax. Thank you for your visits and your trust.
Questions are welcome at the front desk.
The offer is valid from {col:promos.start_date} to {col:promos.end_date}. Discount: {col:promos.discount_pct} off the price of the service. It cannot be added to another offer.
So far {col:promos.redeemed} clients used it, with {col:promos.discount_given} in discount given and {col:promos.revenue} in revenue. Status: {col:promos.status}.
The front desk checks the terms at booking and writes the promotion on the appointment.
Menu margin review for one service
Menu margin review of {set:company}, dated {today}. Service {col:menu_review.service}, reviewed on {col:menu_review.last_reviewed} by {col:menu_review.owner}.
Margin per chair hour {col:menu_review.margin_hour}. Verdict: {col:menu_review.verdict}. Decision: {col:menu_review.decision}.
Actions, owners and dates are written below.
Price rise plan for one service
Price rise plan of {set:company}, dated {today}. Service {col:rise_plan.service}: from {col:rise_plan.current_price} to {col:rise_plan.planned_price}, starting on {col:rise_plan.start_date}.

Change: {col:rise_plan.change_pct}. About {col:rise_plan.appts_month} appointments a month and {col:rise_plan.expected_loss} of clients expected to be lost. New margin per chair hour {col:rise_plan.new_margin_hour}.
Monthly margin gain after expected losses: {col:rise_plan.monthly_gain}. Status: {col:rise_plan.status}.
Clients are told in advance and the booking page is changed on the start date.
Deposit and cancellation policy of {set:company}, dated {today}. Rule {col:deposits.dep_id}: {col:deposits.rule}.

A deposit of {col:deposits.deposit} holds a booking from a price of {col:deposits.price_from}. If you do not come and do not cancel, {col:deposits.noshow_amount} is kept. If you cancel inside the notice time, {col:deposits.late_amount} is kept.
The deposit is taken off the price on the day. Check your own local rules before you use this wording.
Package price sheet of {set:company}, dated {today}. Package of {set:package_sessions} sessions of {col:services.service}.
Single price {col:services.price}. Package price {col:services.pack_price}, which is {set:package_discount} off. The package is paid in advance and each session is booked at the front desk.
Margin per chair hour in the package: {col:services.pack_hour}. The package ends after its valid days; ask the front desk for the date.
Unused sessions are not paid back in cash.
Nearby price comparison of {set:company}, dated {today}. Service {col:nearby.service}, checked on {col:nearby.checked_on}.
{col:nearby.studio} charges {col:nearby.price} for {col:nearby.minutes} minutes and has a review score of {col:nearby.review_score}. Our price: {col:nearby.our_price}.

Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the lowest margin per chair hour, the overhead per chair hour, the deposit, the local sales tax and your usual discounts.

Check Services. Each row is a service with its minutes, price, product cost, deposit and pay. Margin per chair hour (what a service leaves after product and pay for each hour of a chair) and the verdict fill in.
Set the lowest margin per hour and per cent for each category on Margin Targets. Services below their target show amber, services that earn less than the overhead show red.
Keep Service Months and Appointments up to date from your booking system export. Margin per appointment, per month and per chair hour calculate themselves.
List the items you use on Items and the quantity used in each service on Product Use. The Services sheet compares the cost from the list with the product cost you typed.
Write every price change on Price History with its reason, and every test on Price Tests. You see the change percent and what the test earned.
Use Promotions, Discount Rules and Combos and Add-ons to see what each offer cost, the lowest price allowed and the margin of a combo.
Record the prices of nearby studios on Nearby Studio Prices. The Services sheet shows which services are priced below or above them.
Set Deposit Rules and read Overhead by Month: it shows your overhead for each booked chair hour against the plan.
Time services on Time Study and plan every rise on Price Rise Plan with the clients you expect to lose and the monthly gain.
Use the 14 calculators for the price to charge, margin, discounts, promotions, price rises, packages, combos, deposits, pay models, time, product cost, nearby prices and what-ifs.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in. Check your own local rules before you use any wording.
Read the Menu and Margin Dashboard and the Charts every month: revenue, margin, discounts, overhead, time over plan and nearby prices.

Appointment book with end check and lead time
One row per appointment: date, times, technician, chair, service, client, source, status, price and deposit; the end time check, the lead time bucket and the phone numbers fill in by themselves.
Technician days with utilisation and overbooked flag
One row per technician and working day: appointments, booked minutes (with set-up) and bookable minutes; utilisation, free minutes, minutes over and the day check fill in by themselves.
Team and outside contacts with booked time
The owner, technicians, front desk and outside contacts with phone and pay model (a booth renter is a technician who rents a chair and keeps their own takings); booked time fills in by itself.
Services with minutes, price and deposit
The 20 services with category, minutes, price and deposit; the deposit share, the price of a chair hour, the deposit check and the appointments booked in the next 14 days fill in by themselves.
Waiting list with days waiting and offer check
One row per client who wants an earlier or different slot: service, technician, wanted-by date and status; days waiting, the offer check and the phone numbers fill in by themselves.
No-shows and late cancels with revenue lost
One row per no-show, late cancel (a cancellation inside the notice time) or early cancel that left a slot empty: price, deposit and fee kept; revenue lost and the deposit check fill in.
Deposit register with days held and refund
One row per deposit: appointment, amount, state, the date it was asked for, paid and settled; days held, the amount still held, the refund and the deposit check fill in by themselves.
Reminder schedule with the no-show rate of each reminder
One row per reminder the front desk sends: hours before, channel, who gets it and the no-show rate seen; days before, the timing check and the gap to your no-show target fill in by themselves.
Booking and cancellation rules with the fee on a deposit
One row per booking rule: who it applies to, notice hours, share of the deposit kept and the exception; notice in days and the fee on a standard deposit fill in. Check your own local rules.
Weekday pattern per technician over 12 weeks
One row per technician and weekday over the last 12 weeks: completed appointments, booked and bookable minutes; utilisation, free minutes, appointments per day and the check fill in by themselves.
Demand by weekday and time band
One row per weekday and time band (morning to 10:59, midday to 12:59, early afternoon to 14:59, late afternoon from 15:00), last 12 weeks; weekday total, share of the day and busiest weekday fill in.
Open slots with offers and the value filled
One row per free window in a technician day: start, minutes free, the service and client it was offered for and the status; the value filled, the days to go and the slot check fill in by themselves.
One row per technician and weekday with a yes or no for a working day; the bookable minutes and hours of that day fill in from your settings. The studio is closed on Sunday.
Time off with the clients to move
One row per day off, holiday or training day: dates, reason and the clients to move to another day; the days off, the days inside the next 30 days and the status fill in by themselves.
Overbooking checks with minutes over and the action taken
One row per full or overbooked technician day: appointments, booked and bookable minutes and the action taken; the minutes over, the appointments to move and the capacity check fill in by themselves.
One row per booking source with the appointments of the last 12 months; the share of all appointments fills in by itself.
Same-day changes with the minutes shifted
One row per change made on the day of an appointment: the kind, the old and new start and the reason; the minutes shifted, the shift check and the phone numbers fill in by themselves.
Appointments, no-shows and revenue by month
One row per month: appointments, no-shows, late cancels, cancelled, booked minutes, revenue and value lost; the no-show rate, the loss rate and revenue per appointment fill in by themselves.
Seasons with demand factor and average appointments
Twelve calendar months with the season and a demand factor; the average appointments of that month (the current month scaled to a full month) and the gap to the average month fill in.
